purpose: Archive the validated dynamic native object-return candidate and all four completed timing comparisons.

decision.next: Inspect observed arithmetic caches and guarded opaque integer operands; preserve conservative behavior for unobserved operands.

packing: Deterministic archives preserve original member paths and bytes. Executable binaries, build/frozen caches, generated standard-library dependency trees, and the live exporter log are excluded. All source identities, validation records, expected baseline failure, disk-space preflight, cache-cleanup inventory, and both test-source versions, codegen, methods, complete census coverage, raw semantic evidence, and all four complete timing datasets are retained. Final complete EXPORT.txt is added after export closes.

checkpoint_filter.purpose: Make cache-free checkpoint copies while preserving the original local archives.
checkpoint_filter.note: Only generated bytecode/cache members are omitted. Every remaining source, test, input, result, failure, and method retains its original bytes. The original manifest is inside the filtered archive. Historical reports and EXPORT logs describe the original archive; use this checkpoint manifest for the committed copies.
